name: Musume to Chichi no Chaos na Ichinichi
original_name: 娘と父のカオスな一日
source:
Because he learned of his wife's infidelity, a certain office worker can no longer love her anymore.

Night after night, he devoted himself to some suspicious research. A girl's screams could be heard from his underground study... 

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21490]Freem![/url]]
translation:
某上班族因为得知妻子的不忠，已经无法再爱她了。

夜复一夜，他致力于一些可疑的研究。地下书房里传来女孩的尖叫声…… 

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21490]Freem![/url]]
